title: Inquiry Plan Approval
learningGoal: Design and document a safe two-sample gravimetric plan with sufficient carbonate, complete evidence, and an explicit teacher-approval gate.

actions.label: Review Ksp and precipitation reasoning

parameters.note: Use solubility-product reasoning to select carbonate as a precipitating ion for Ca2+. The simulator does not reveal an unknown outcome before the plan is submitted.
parameters.instruction: Use the prelab Ksp evidence to justify CaCO3 precipitation without treating the selection as hidden outcome instruction.

actions.label: Define carbonate-excess plan

parameters.note: The approved simulator plan uses 12.0 mL of 0.50 M Na2CO3 for each 20.0 mL concentrated aliquot. This supplies 0.00600 mol carbonate, enough for 0.6005 g CaCO3, which exceeds the larger configured 0.5600 g sample result.
